objective: Add standard-library contract tests for the Queensland reference-only profile: structural schema, source provenance, unit semantics, nonnegative bounded counts, denominator reconciliation, explicit unknown evidence, and negative controls. Do not turn aggregates into hazards or create site defaults.
steps: Add contract tests using the repository's standard-library unittest lane; avoid adding a validator dependency to the Python 3.15.1 environment.
Validate schema shape, source provenance and URLs, source-specific units, nonnegative integer counts, category uniqueness, mother/baby denominators and aggregate reconciliation.

Retain explicit missing site evidence, unknown correlations and non-runnable/reference-only status; assert current policy revisions remain separate from the 2022 data year and conflicting review dates remain unresolved.
Include negative controls for malformed counts, denominator mismatch, unit mismatch, invented site staffing and dropped unresolved evidence.
Run packet validation, focused unittest, diff check and Conductor integrity checks; capture command outputs and runtime in the evidence receipt.
Obtain reviewer-agent review of the exact commit and address findings before coordinator acceptance.

verification.oracle: The B0.3 packet is bound to the exact base, accepted B0.2 prerequisite and unchanged source hashes.
All reference-profile structural, provenance, unit, range and negative-control tests execute and pass.
Staged test, packet and evidence changes have no whitespace errors.

acceptance: The version-1 profile structure, source provenance, and source table metadata are checked without depending on an unqualified third-party schema library.
Counts are nonnegative integers; mother-level population/onset distributions and baby-level route counts reconcile to their explicitly named denominators.
Source units, year and revision boundaries are checked; maternal and baby counts are never conflated.
Missing site staffing/eligibility/timing evidence, unresolved correlations, non-runnable status and review-date conflicts remain explicit under mutation tests.
Reviewer-agent/subagent has reviewed the exact implementation commit and all findings have been addressed before coordinator acceptance.
stop_conditions: A test would require a clinically selected threshold or invented site parameter
The test requires adding an unqualified dependency
Any edit escapes the exact write paths
